instructorNote: This is a noise inject. It is a single Campylobacter report collected on 10/08, two days before the supper. It is a routine Level 1 case for Pell County and does not go on the supper line list. Watch whether EPI rules it out on collection date and whether NM routes it for routine interview and referral to Pell County. Players should also log the known gaps: one duty phone with no texting, and nobody checked it all weekend. If asked, the phone also shows one hang-up voicemail.
